groups.label: Relate a relation to the cartesian product

statements.text: A relation from X to Y, where X, Y are two non-empty sets, connects some or all of the elements of X with some or all of the elements of Y.
X × Y is the set of ordered pairs where the first projection in each ordered pair belongs to X and the second projection belongs to Y. Formula: $X\times Y$
If R is a relation from X to Y, then R is a subset of X × Y. Formula: $R\subset X\times Y$

groups.label: Represent a relation on a set itself

statements.text: If R is a relation from a set X to X (itself), then R is called a relation on X, and R ⊂ X × X. Formula: $R\subset X\times X$
